comment: Red team 1_6 (threat_behind_thin_wall, aimed at #8,#9,#7): A thin cross wall has its short side on the left (8 % shorter), but a known threat far behind-left is hidden only from the right side, so the rules require a right bypass. A shortest-side bias or a late threat check sends the squad left, and the end may get no slice. Broke 1 (check, choice, members): #1 wall stare. First: #1 hedgehog n4 R1 s1 t=15.2s - L at W1.
